description: This file contains implementation of Orleans grain classes for internal testing of timer functionalities, including timer management, reentrancy, self-disposing timers, and context validation within grains. It defines multiple grain classes such as TimerGrain, TimerCallGrain, and their variants, with methods for starting, stopping, and testing timers, as well as handling timer callbacks and context checks.

classes.name: TimerGrain
classes.description: A grain implementing timer management, including starting, stopping, and handling timer callbacks with context validation.

classes.name: TimerCallGrain
classes.description: A grain that manages timers with advanced control, including restart, stop, self-disposing timers, and callback processing with context checks.

classes.name: NonReentrantTimerCallGrain
classes.description: A grain designed to test non-reentrant timer behavior, ensuring no overlapping executions and validating context and interleaving.

classes.name: PocoTimerGrain
classes.description: A Plain Old CLR Object (POCO) implementation of a timer grain, managing timers with context validation.

classes.name: PocoTimerCallGrain
classes.description: A POCO implementation managing timers with advanced control, similar to TimerCallGrain but as a POCO.

classes.name: PocoNonReentrantTimerCallGrain
classes.description: A POCO implementation for testing non-reentrant timer behavior with context validation.

classes.name: TimerRequestGrain
classes.description: A grain for testing timer request overloads, including starting timers with different overloads and waiting for callbacks.

classes.name: PocoTimerRequestGrain
classes.description: A POCO version of TimerRequestGrain, managing timers with context validation and overload testing.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Handles activation logic, initializes context and timers.

methods.name: Tick
methods.description: Timer callback that increments counter and logs information.

methods.name: SetCounter
methods.description: Sets the counter to a specified value.

methods.name: StartTimer
methods.description: Starts a timer with a given name.

methods.name: StopTimer
methods.description: Stops a timer with a given name.

methods.name: LongWait
methods.description: Performs a long wait using Thread.Sleep.

methods.name: ThrowIfDeactivating
methods.description: Throws if the grain is in deactivating state.

methods.name: StartTimer
methods.description: Starts a timer with delay and optional operation type.

methods.name: RestartTimer
methods.description: Restarts a timer with a new delay and optional period.

methods.name: RunSelfDisposingTimer
methods.description: Creates a timer that disposes itself after execution.

methods.name: ProcessTimerTick
methods.description: Processes a timer tick, calling grain methods and validating context.

methods.name: CheckRuntimeContext
methods.description: Validates that the current runtime context matches the expected context.

methods.name: LogStatus
methods.description: Logs the current status of the timer callback.
